name: 04 Coastal Evolution v2
description: The firm's own identity, elevated: charcoal and teal, Newsreader serif headings, square corners and hairline rules, left-aligned editorial layouts, a deliberate rhythm of dark, light, tinted and photo sections. Content-driven: every module renders slots from content/structured.

notes.dark: charcoal ground (header, hero, title banner, photo sections)
notes.accent: deep teal ground with white text, or photo with charcoal overlay
notes.teal usage: #008fa5 for rules, numerals 24px and up and borders only; #006f83 for text and button grounds on light; #5cc8da for text on charcoal
notes.band: closing contact band: deeper teal tint, thick teal rule on top, charcoal text; set apart from the charcoal footer
